title: Balaam's Oracles

questions.question: How many altars did Balaam ask Balak to build?
questions.explanation: Numbers 23:1 (ESV): "Build for me here seven altars..."

questions.question: Instead of cursing, what did Balaam do?
questions.explanation: Numbers 23:11 (ESV): "I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have done nothing but bless them."

questions.question: In the first oracle, Balaam said, "How can I curse whom...?"
questions.explanation: Numbers 23:8 (ESV): "How can I curse whom God has not cursed?"

questions.question: In the second oracle, Balaam said, "God is not man, that he should...?"
questions.explanation: Numbers 23:19 (ESV): "God is not man, that he should lie, or a son of man, that he should change his mind."

questions.question: What did Balak do after the first blessing?
options: He took him to another place (Field of Zophim)
questions.correctAnswer: He took him to another place (Field of Zophim)
questions.explanation: Numbers 23:14 (ESV): "And he took him to the field of Zophim..."

questions.question: Balaam compared Israel's strength to what animal?
questions.explanation: Numbers 23:22 (ESV): "They have as it were the horns of a wild ox."

questions.question: What did Balaam say about omens against Jacob?
options: There is no enchantment against Jacob, no omen against Israel
questions.correctAnswer: There is no enchantment against Jacob, no omen against Israel
questions.explanation: Numbers 23:23 (ESV): "For there is no enchantment against Jacob, no omen against Israel."

questions.question: From where did Balaam view the people first?
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:41 (preceding 23:1): "...took Balaam and brought him up to Bamoth-baal, and from there he saw a fraction of the people."

questions.question: What animals were sacrificed on each altar?
questions.explanation: Numbers 23:2 (ESV): "...offered on each altar a bull and a ram."

questions.question: Balaam wished his end to be like whom?
questions.explanation: Numbers 23:10 (ESV): "Let me die the death of the upright, and let my end be like his!"

questions.question: The Lord put a word in Balaam's mouth. Where did Balaam go to receive it?
options: He went to a bare height separate from Balak
questions.correctAnswer: He went to a bare height separate from Balak
questions.explanation: Numbers 23:3 (ESV): "Stand beside your burnt offering, and I will go... And he went to a bare height."

questions.question: Balaam described the people of Israel as dwelling how?
options: Alone, and not counting itself among the nations
questions.correctAnswer: Alone, and not counting itself among the nations
questions.explanation: Numbers 23:9 (ESV): "Behold, a people dwelling alone, and not counting itself among the nations!"

questions.question: In the second oracle, Balaam said the Lord has not beheld what in Jacob?
questions.explanation: Numbers 23:21 (ESV): "He has not beheld misfortune in Jacob, nor has he seen trouble in Israel."

questions.question: Where was the third location Balak took Balaam?
questions.explanation: Numbers 23:28 (ESV): "And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor..."

questions.question: Did Balak build seven altars at the third location too?
questions.explanation: Numbers 23:29-30 (ESV): "Build for me here seven altars... And Balak did as Balaam had said..."

key_verse_text: God is not man, that he should lie, or a son of man, that he should change his mind. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or has he spoken, and will he not fulfill it?
